name: Troll, Fladså
body:
FLADSÅ TROLL
CR 3

This 8-foot-tall troll is covered in shaggy white fur, with a kindly face and a long nose and a cow’s tail dangling from its backside.

XP 800
N Large humanoid (giant)
Init +2; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, poison scent; Perception +8

DEFENSE

AC 15, touch 12, flat-footed 13 (+2 Dex, +3 natural)
hp 34 (4d8+16)
Fort +8, Ref +3, Will +4
Defensive Abilities lapidify, rock catching; Resist cold 10

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee slam +5 (1d6+3)
Ranged rock +5 (2d6+4)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 5 ft.
Special Attacks rock throwing (60 ft.)

STATISTICS

Str 16, Dex 14, Con 18, Int 13, Wis 16, Cha 17
Base Atk +3; CMB +7; CMD 19
Feats Cunning, Skill Focus (Knowledge (nature))
Skills Bluff +3 (+7 while using change shape), Craft (any one) +6, Diplomacy +3 (+7 while using change shape), Disable Device +4, Disguise +7, Handle Animal +8, Heal +8, Knowledge (nature) +6, Perception +8, Profession (any one) +8, Survival +8; Racial Modifiers +4 Bluff (while using change shape), +4 Diplomacy (while using change shape), +4 Disguise
Languages Common, Giant
SQ change shape (alter self, Small or Medium humanoid), tell tail

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Lapidify (Su)

A fladså can turn itself to stone at will, along with any garments and equipment worn or carried, gaining hardness 8.

It may remain in this state for as long as it likes, and can see, hear, and smell normally in this form, but does not need to eat or breathe. Feeling is limited to sensations which can affect its granite-hard body.

Poison Scent (Ex)

A fladså has the scent ability, but only to detect poisons, creatures and objects that have been poisoned, and creatures that are naturally poisonous. When a fladså uses a move action to note the direction of a scent, it can make a DC 20 Wisdom check (or DC 20 Craft (alchemy) check) to determine the exact type of poison.

Tell Tail (Ex)

A fladså’s change shape ability does not alter its cow-like tail. If anyone makes a Perception check to examine a fladså using its change shape ability, they spot its tail if they beat its Disguise check by 5 or more and may immediately make a Knowledge (local) check to recognize that they’ve seen a fladså.

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary, pair, or family (2 plus 1d3 fladsålings)
Treasure incidental

Fladså resemble the fey in their behavior more than other trolls, despite being related to them. They are sometimes found in villages, sometimes as solitary creatures, fladså tend to possess a craft similar to humans; those that befriend a fladså have a chance to receive assistance from the fladså in the dark of night – their crops seem to remain unaffected by pests or their livestock particularly productive; some artificers have even spoken of machines being fixed that have befuddled them for months.

Younger, smaller fladså are known to be tricksters and are fond of pranking other humanoids nearby (other fladså included) or stealing livestock. As they get older, they learn to use their shape shifting to appear as incredibly attractive members of other races; however, a quirk seems to be that they always retain their cow’s tails no matter what shape they take. A good way to mitigate this seems to be bribes; a fresh, large bowl of porridge seems to be a consistent favorite, although other generous bribes seem to sate the fladså and prevent particularly egregious pranks.

A fladsåling (“small fladså”) is a fladså with the young creature template. A fladsåling does not receive racial bonuses to Bluff or Diplomacy.
